suggested_improvements: [LAYOUT] Problem: The 'Proofreading' label sits at C1, ~3 grid columns away from the polymerase it annotates (D4-D5) and its left edge crowds the lecture-text margin.; Solution: Line 160: self.place_at_grid(proofreading_label, 'C4', scale_factor=0.8) to center it one row above the polymerase, keeping it within 1 grid unit and clear of the lecture column.

[LAYOUT] Problem: The counter's assigned area E2-F5 includes cell E5, which is occupied by the success checkmark, creating a cramped vertical stack above the formula's right end.; Solution: Line 190: self.place_in_area(counter, 'F2', 'F4', scale_factor=0.9) to reserve row E for the checkmark and center '1 error in 10^9' under the strand diagram.

[LAYOUT] Problem: The 'Polymerase' label rests near E3 while the enzyme body ends at D4-D5, leaving the label offset left of its object at the final frame.; Solution: Line 120: self.place_at_grid(polymerase_label, 'E4', scale_factor=0.8) so the label stays directly beneath the enzyme body within 1 grid unit.
